n=19
centers={(3,6):8,(4,13):4,(12,14):1,(14,3):2}
objs={
 (3,6):{(3,6),(2,6),(3,5),(3,7),(4,6)},
 (4,13):{(4,13),(3,13),(4,12),(4,14),(5,13)},
 (12,14):{(12,14),(11,14),(12,13),(12,15),(13,14)},
 (14,3):{(14,3),(13,3),(14,2),(14,4),(15,3)},
 (10,8):{(10,8),(9,8),(10,7),(10,9),(11,8)}}
all_markers=set().union(*objs.values())-set(centers)
h=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]; v=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for (r,c),color in centers.items():
    own=objs[(r,c)]
    for dr,dc,target in ((0,-1,h),(0,1,h),(-1,0,v),(1,0,v)):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<n and 0<=cc<n:
            if (rr,cc) in all_markers-own: break
            target[rr][cc]=color
            rr+=dr;cc+=dc
out=[[v[r][c] if v[r][c] else h[r][c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
for r,c in all_markers:out[r][c]=3
for (r,c),color in centers.items():out[r][c]=color
assert len(out)==19 and all(len(row)==19 for row in out)
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
